## Security

Four security vulnerabilities have been identified, and fixed, in this release. Users are advised to update gh to version `v2.102.0` as soon as possible.

`gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` could write remote content to an unintended local file when the destination contained symbolic links.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-39wj-f2f4-978v for more information.

`gh attestation verify` compared the `--source-ref` value case-insensitively, so an attestation built from a branch whose name differs only in case could satisfy a policy that named a different branch.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-4mq3-hpgx-9cx8 for more information.

Interactive `gh skill search` passed repository paths from search results to `gh skill install` without an option separator, so a search result could inject installer options and change where skill files were written.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-qcwj-mr2r-2cx7 for more information.

`gh attestation verify` matched the `--signer-workflow` value against only the start of the signing certificate's identity, so an attestation signed by a different workflow in the pinned repository could pass verification when its path began with the pinned value.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-wjmr-j3rp-mh2g for more information.

title.zh-TW: 修復四處安全漏洞，防範非預期檔案寫入與驗證被繞過
title.en: Fix Four Security Vulnerabilities to Prevent Unexpected File Writes and Verification Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 下載、安裝技能或驗證產物時不再受惡意名稱所害，建議盡快升到 `v2.102.0`。`gh release download`、`gh run download`、`gh repo read-file --output` 與 `gh attestation download` 遇目的地含符號連結（指向其他位置的捷徑檔）時，以前可能寫入非預期的本機檔案。`gh attestation verify` 以前比對 `--source-ref` 不分大小寫，且 `--signer-workflow` 只比憑證身分開頭，僅大小寫不同的分支，或同儲存庫內路徑開頭相同的另一個工作流程，都可能通過驗證。互動式 `gh skill search` 傳路徑給 `gh skill install` 時缺少選項分隔符號，搜尋結果可能注入安裝選項並改寫檔案位置。⟦就像同一棟樓四扇門的鎖被一次補好。⟧
body.en: Downloading artifacts, installing skills, or verifying attestations is no longer vulnerable to malicious names, and upgrading to `v2.102.0` as soon as possible is recommended. When the destination contains a symlink, `gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` previously risked writing to unintended local files. `gh attestation verify` previously compared `--source-ref` case-insensitively and only matched the prefix of certificate identities for `--signer-workflow`, allowing branches differing only by case or another workflow with a matching path prefix in the same repository to pass verification. Interactive `gh skill search` lacked an option delimiter when passing paths to `gh skill install`, which allowed search results to inject installation options and alter file locations. ⟦Picture locks on four doors of the same building being fixed all at once.⟧

## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: Linux 上用 APT 或 RPM 裝的 gh 要認新金鑰
title.en: gh installed via APT or RPM on Linux needs the new signing key

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新 `gh`，卻突然裝不起來、報簽章驗證失敗？多半是金鑰換了。GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與更新軟體的官方來源），連同個別的 RPM 套件檔，現在只用新的 PGP 金鑰簽署，指紋是 `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`。如果你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前從官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫裝了 `gh`，又還沒更新金鑰圈（電腦裡記著哪些簽章可以信任的清單），安裝或更新就可能失敗。⟦就像快遞改用新封條，你家警衛只認得舊封條，包裹就會被擋在門外，得先把新封條的樣子告訴警衛。⟧照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換說明檢查、更新金鑰圈就能解決。用 Windows、macOS，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器、原始碼安裝的人不受影響。
body.en: Updating `gh` on Linux and suddenly getting a signature verification failure? The signing key most likely changed. GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key, fingerprint `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`. If you installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026 and haven't refreshed your keyring, installs and updates may fail. ⟦It's like a courier switching to a new seal: your building's guard only knows the old one, so packages get turned away until you show the guard what the new seal looks like.⟧ Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and anyone who installed through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: gh 登入時自動幫你複製驗證碼
title.en: gh now copies your login code for you

body.zh-TW:
用 `gh auth login` 登入 GitHub，或用 `gh auth refresh` 更新權限時，畫面會給你一組 OAuth 裝置代碼（要貼到瀏覽器授權頁、證明是你本人在登入的短碼）。以前你得自己反白、複製，再切到瀏覽器貼上；現在這兩個指令預設會直接把代碼放進剪貼簿，切過去按貼上就好。⟦櫃檯人員直接把號碼牌塞到你手上，你就不必再拿筆抄一次號碼。⟧不想要這個行為，可以用下面這行永久關掉：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

某一次執行時如果你另外指定了剪貼簿選項，那一次就照你指定的來。
body.en:
When you sign in with `gh auth login` or refresh permissions with `gh auth refresh`, the screen gives you an OAuth device code to paste into the browser's authorization page. You used to highlight it, copy it, then switch to the browser and paste. Now both commands put the code on your clipboard by default, so you just switch over and paste. ⟦Think of a service desk where the clerk hands you the ticket instead of making you copy the number down with a pen.⟧ To turn this off for good, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

If you pass an explicit clipboard option on a single run, that run follows your choice.

## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

## Attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

The repeatable `--attach` flag uploads local images and videos and adds them to issue, pull request, or comment bodies. If a body already references the local path, `gh` replaces it with the uploaded URL; otherwise it appends the attachment:

```shell
# Attach files when creating or editing an issue
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh issue edit 123 --attach ./walkthrough.mp4

# Attach files when creating or editing a pull request
gh pr create --attach ./before.png
gh pr edit 456 --attach ./after.png

# Attach files to comments
gh issue comment 123 --attach ./repro.png
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

Repeat the flag to attach multiple files in a single invocation. Attachments are available on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

For more information see https://gh.io/gh-attach and https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/

## Worktree support extended to `gh issue develop` 

`gh issue develop` can now create a linked branch and check it out in a new Git worktree, leaving your current working copy unchanged:

```shell
# Create a linked branch for an issue and check it out in a worktree
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

title.zh-TW: 在命令列直接把截圖和影片附進 issue 與 PR
title.en: Attach screenshots and videos to issues and PRs from the command line

body.zh-TW:
⟦你把沖洗好的照片一張張貼進日誌本，寫到哪一頁就貼在哪一頁；頁面上原本寫著「照片放這裡」的位置，照片會直接蓋上去，其他頁則往後補貼。⟧回報問題時想附一張截圖，以前得先開網頁上傳。現在 `gh` 多了 `--attach`，直接把本機的圖片和影片傳上去，接進 issue、pull request 或留言的內文。

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

內文若已經寫到那個本機路徑，`gh` 會把它換成上傳後的網址；沒寫到就補在最後。同一次指令要附多個檔案，就重複寫幾次這個旗標。這功能在 GitHub.com 與 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上都能用。
body.en:
⟦You paste developed photos into a logbook page by page: where a page already says "photo goes here", the print covers that spot; elsewhere it goes on at the end.⟧ Reporting a bug with a screenshot used to mean opening the web page to upload it first. `gh` now has `--attach`, which uploads local images and videos and puts them into the body of an issue, a pull request, or a comment.

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

If the body already references that local path, `gh` swaps in the uploaded URL; otherwise the attachment is appended. Repeat the flag to attach several files in one invocation. Attachments work on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

title.zh-TW: `gh issue develop` 能另開工作目錄，手上的東西不用收
title.en: `gh issue develop` can check the branch out in a separate worktree

body.zh-TW:
手邊的改動改到一半，issue 那頭又要你開一條新分支——以前得先收拾現場才能切過去。現在 `gh issue develop` 可以幫 issue 建好連動的分支，並且把它簽出到一個新的 Git worktree（工作樹，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），你目前這份工作目錄原封不動。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要趕另一項工程時，不必把現場拆掉重排，而是在旁邊另闢一塊作業區，兩邊同時進行。⟧
body.en:
You are halfway through a change when an issue needs a fresh branch, and until now you had to tidy up before switching over. `gh issue develop` can now create the linked branch for an issue and check it out in a new Git worktree, a second working copy of the same project that stands on its own, leaving your current working copy untouched.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦When a site has to start a second job, the crew does not tear down what is already laid out; they open a separate work area beside it and run both at once.⟧

title.zh-TW: `gh pr checkout` 支援工作樹，切換 PR 不必動既有檔案
title.en: `gh pr checkout` adds `--worktree` to check out PRs into parallel copies

body.zh-TW: 正寫程式寫到一半，同事突然請你幫忙測試別人的 PR（pull request，請求將程式碼合併進專案的提案）。⟦像在圖書館查資料時直接影印一份副本帶到另一張桌子讀，原桌上攤開的筆記完全不用收拾。⟧這正是輸入 `gh pr checkout 123 --worktree` 的時刻。加上 `--worktree` 旗標後，系統會替該 PR 建立獨立的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。你能在新資料夾查看與測試變更，目前的檔案與分支留在原地，不必先把未完成的修改暫存收起。
body.en: While coding mid-task, a teammate asks you to test someone's PR (pull request). ⟦It is like photocopying a reference book in a library to read at another table without clearing your existing desk notes.⟧ That is the moment to run `gh pr checkout 123 --worktree`. Passing the `--worktree` flag creates an independent worktree, Git's feature for parallel working copies. You can inspect and test the changes in a separate folder while your current branch and files stay undisturbed.

items.original: Add --worktree flag to gh pr checkout by @tidy-dev in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/13946

title.zh-TW: issue 搜尋加入 `--search-type`，支援語意與混合查詢
title.en: `gh search issues` adds `--search-type` for semantic and hybrid search

body.zh-TW: 在專案裡搜尋 issue（議題，追蹤問題與建議的討論清單）時，以前只能比對一模一樣的關鍵字。⟦像找歌時忘記歌名，哼出大概的旋律能按感覺找；若還記得一小段歌詞，便把歌詞片段和旋律一起交給找歌的人。⟧`gh search issues` 現在新增了 `--search-type` 旗標，支援語意搜尋與混合搜尋兩種模式。當你記不清確切的錯誤文字時，輸入概念描述並加上 `--search-type semantic`，便能依背後涵義找出相近的討論；加上 `--search-type hybrid` 則會同時比對關鍵字與語意。
body.en: When searching for issues in a repository, you used to rely strictly on exact keyword matches. ⟦It is like finding a song from a rough hummed melody, then giving the song finder both that melody and a remembered lyric fragment when you have one.⟧ `gh search issues` now introduces the `--search-type` flag, supporting both semantic and hybrid search modes. If you cannot remember the exact error text, pass `--search-type semantic` with a natural concept description to find relevant issues by meaning; using `--search-type hybrid` combines traditional keyword matching with semantic understanding.

title.zh-TW: 呼叫擴充套件自動帶入 `GH_EXTENSION=1`，身分識別更明確
title.en: `gh` sets `GH_EXTENSION=1` when executing extensions

body.zh-TW: 撰寫或執行 GitHub CLI 擴充套件（extension，為 gh 新增自訂指令的附加工具）時，程式往往需要知道自己是怎麼被啟動的。⟦像員工佩戴公司發放的識別證進場，保全一眼就能確認他是從內部系統派來的，而不是自行闖入的外部訪客。⟧`gh` 現在在叫用任何擴充套件時，都會在環境變數（開程式之前預先塞給它的隱藏開關，一般使用者看不到）自動帶上 `GH_EXTENSION=1`。這讓擴充套件能藉由檢查該變數，確認自己正在被 `gh` 呼叫，並據此調整輸出格式或執行流程。
body.en: When writing or running a GitHub CLI extension (an add-on tool that introduces custom commands to gh), the program often needs to know how it was started. ⟦It is like an employee wearing a company badge into the building so security immediately recognizes they were dispatched by the internal system rather than entering unannounced.⟧ When `gh` invokes any extension, it now automatically sets the environment variable `GH_EXTENSION=1`. Extensions can check this variable to confirm they are running under `gh` and adjust their output formatting or behavior accordingly.

items.original: Set GH_EXTENSION=1 when gh invokes an extension by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14072

title.zh-TW: 修正 `RESTWithNext` 錯誤型態，恢復 `gh status` 與 attestation 重試
title.en: Fixed `RESTWithNext` error type to restore `gh status` and attestation retries

body.zh-TW: 查詢 `gh status` 時若遇到可重試的失敗，錯誤型態 `RESTWithNext` 的判斷曾讓重試失效。現在已修正，`gh status` 和 attestation（證明軟體產物來源與建置過程的數位簽署證明）都能重新嘗試，不會在第一次失敗後停住。⟦這像送件窗口發現回條有誤時，不再直接把整份文件退回，而是讓它回到處理隊伍再送一次。⟧
body.en: When `gh status` hits a retryable failure, the `RESTWithNext` error-type handling had prevented retries. That is fixed: both `gh status` and attestations (digital signatures that verify a software artifact's origin and build process) can retry again. ⟦It is like a filing desk returning a form with a faulty receipt to the processing queue instead of rejecting the whole submission.⟧

items.original: Fix `RESTWithNext` error type, repairing `gh status` and attestation retries by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/13988

title.zh-TW: `gh release create` 解析權限範圍時會去除空白

body.en: When creating a release, `gh release create` reads permission scopes from the `X-Oauth-Scopes` header. Its parser now strips extra surrounding whitespace so that whitespace is not treated as part of a scope name. ⟦It is like erasing stray spaces beside names on a roster so one person is not mistaken for another.⟧

Its output in that case is fixed, so the command emits the correct output in non-interactive environments. ⟦It is like a shipping form that skips the service-desk screen and enters an automated sorting line while still printing the correct machine-readable label.⟧

items.original: Fix project item-add output for non-TTY by @zwick in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14056

title.zh-TW: 七項 API 請求收攏至 `api.Client`，統一金鑰與發布通道
title.en: Seven API request flows routed through unified `api.Client`

body.zh-TW: 手邊的 GitHub CLI 指令照舊可用，不必因內部 API 連線架構重整而切換操作方式。⟦像一棟大樓原本各辦公室各自拉電話線對外聯絡，現在全面改由中央總機統籌轉接，線路更整齊且便於維護。⟧開發團隊將七項操作的 HTTP 請求全面收攏至統一的 `api.Client`（負責管理連線與驗證的共用用戶端模組）。涵蓋對象包含 deploy key、ssh key、gpg key 三類金鑰，以及 autolink 自動連結、extension 擴充套件、release 建立與 release 刪除。請求集中由共用用戶端發送後，程式碼結構更乾淨，連線行為也維持一致。
body.en: Your existing GitHub CLI commands remain the same despite an internal API architecture refactor. ⟦It is like a building replacing separate external phone lines in every office with a centralized switchboard, keeping wiring tidy and maintainable.⟧ The team routed HTTP requests for seven operations through the unified `api.Client` (the shared client module managing connections and authentication). This covers deploy keys, ssh keys, gpg keys, autolinks, extensions, release creation, and release deletions. Routing these calls through a single client keeps network logic clean and consistent across the codebase.

Its comments are shorter, its decisions are cheaper and more decisive, and it now performs a real code-reachability check: whether a code path can actually reach a vulnerability. ⟦Rather than merely spotting a broken door on a building plan, it follows the corridor to see whether that door can really be reached.⟧

title.zh-TW: 新增排程清理技術債技能，定期維護專案程式碼

body.zh-TW: 專案維護久了，程式庫常累積零星的待辦標記、過時設定或待整理的舊結構，平時卻抽不出完整時間手動整理。專案現在為 AI 代理新增了排程清理技術債技能（tech debt burndown skill，定期處理專案累積技術債務的專用指令技能）。在排程設定中啟用並排定觸發時間後，代理便會按固定週期自動檢視並清理這些技術債。⟦像在大樓日誌裡排定例行大掃除，定期把倉庫堆積的雜物與舊箱子清運出去，不讓零碎雜物越積越多。⟧透過將清債任務標準化與排程化，專案能持續維持程式碼的整潔度與健康度。
body.en: As a repository grows, it often accumulates lingering TODOs, outdated configurations, or disorganized code structures that developers rarely have dedicated time to clean up. The project now introduces a scheduled tech debt burndown skill for AI agents. Once configured with a schedule, the agent automatically triggers on a recurring interval to inspect the codebase and clean up technical debt. ⟦It is like putting a regular deep-cleaning schedule on the building calendar to clear out accumulated clutter from the storage room before it piles up.⟧ Standardizing and scheduling these cleanups helps teams keep the repository tidy and maintainable over time.

title.zh-TW: 部署驗證接受預發布標籤
title.en: Deployment validation accepts pre-release tags

body.zh-TW: 部署流程驗證版本標籤時，現在接受預發布（pre-release，正式發布前使用的版本標籤）標籤。預發布標籤用來標示正式發布之前的版本；部署驗證會把這一類標籤視為可接受的輸入。⟦像活動入口除了正式票券，也核驗試營運場次的票券，兩種票都能通過入口。⟧這項調整只改部署驗證對標籤的接受條件，讓使用預發布標籤的部署流程不必在驗證處被擋下。
body.en: When a deployment flow validates a version tag, it now accepts a pre-release tag, a tag for a version before formal release. Deployment validation therefore treats that tag type as acceptable input. ⟦It is like an event entrance validating tickets for a trial-run session as well as tickets for the formal opening, letting both through the gate.⟧ The change is limited to which tags deployment validation accepts, so a deployment using a pre-release tag is not stopped at that check.

items.original: Accept pre-release tags in deployment validation by @BagToad in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14193

title.zh-TW: 以 `reflect.Pointer` 取代已淘汰的 `reflect.Ptr`
title.en: Replaced deprecated `reflect.Ptr` with `reflect.Pointer`

body.zh-TW: 程式碼把已淘汰的 `reflect.Ptr` 改為 `reflect.Pointer`，完成一次 API（應用程式介面，程式用來呼叫功能的固定方式）替換。這不是新增另一種呼叫方式，而是將原先使用的過時名稱換成目前的名稱。⟦像把老舊規格的轉接頭換成現行規格，插在原本位置仍是為了完成同一段連接。⟧若你正在閱讀相關程式碼，看到 `reflect.Pointer` 就是在辨認這項替換後使用的 API。
body.en: Code now replaces deprecated `reflect.Ptr` with `reflect.Pointer`, completing an API (application programming interface, a fixed way for programs to call a capability) substitution. This does not add a second way to make the call; it changes the outdated name that the code used to the current one. ⟦It is like swapping an old-standard adapter for one that meets the current standard while using the same connection point.⟧ When reading the relevant code, `reflect.Pointer` is the API used after this replacement.

items.original: Use reflect.Pointer instead of deprecated reflect.Ptr by @williammartin in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14098

title.zh-TW: 不需要清理時不再要求功能偵測註解
title.en: Feature detection no longer requests cleanup comments when unneeded

body.zh-TW: 功能偵測（feature detection，先確認功能是否可用的做法）不需要清理時，現在不再要求清理註解。這條規則把是否需要清理當成是否提出註解要求的界線：有清理需要的地方可留下相應註解，沒有清理需要的地方則不因同一件事再被要求補註。⟦像工作單只在確有後續收尾工作時附上提醒；沒有待收尾的項目，就不多附一張提醒單。⟧改動的重點是刪除不必要的要求，讓註解要求和實際清理需要對齊。
body.en: When feature detection (checking whether a capability is available) needs no cleanup, it no longer requests a cleanup comment. Whether cleanup is needed now forms the boundary for asking for that comment: a corresponding comment can be left where cleanup is needed, but an item needing none is not asked for one. ⟦It is like attaching a reminder to a work order only when follow-up work really remains; an item with nothing to finish gets no extra reminder slip.⟧ The change removes an unneeded request so that the request for a comment matches the actual need for cleanup.

items.original: Don't ask for feature detection cleanup comments when not needed by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14139

body.zh-TW: 你在 GitHub Project（把工作拆成卡片和欄位的管理看板）裡找待辦事項，不必先翻出那串難記的 ID 了。`gh project item-edit` 現在能依名稱找到項目；像整理「修登入頁」這張卡時，可直接用它的名字指定對象。`gh project item-list` 也能把具名欄位列出來，清單不再只像一排沒有標籤的抽屜。搜尋某個儲存庫時，`gh search --repo` 會提示 `OWNER/REPO` 格式，文件也把依名稱編輯列為主要做法。
body.en: When you are looking for a task in a GitHub Project, you no longer have to dig up its hard-to-remember ID first. `gh project item-edit` can now resolve an item by name, so you can target a card such as “Fix login page” by its name. `gh project item-list` can show named field columns too, rather than a row of unlabeled drawers. `gh search --repo` now hints at the `OWNER/REPO` format, and the docs present name-based editing as the main Project flow.

The project now includes a code-review agent skill: instructions for an agent doing code review. Think of a toolbox gaining a new adapter for Grok while the old Windsurf slot is relabeled Devin, with no wrapped label getting in the way.

title.zh-TW: 驗證缺根憑證不再卡死，macOS 解鎖多等一分鐘
title.en: Missing verifier roots no longer halt setup; macOS keyring access gets a minute

body.zh-TW: 開啟 GitHub CLI 時，驗證器需要的 trusted root（用來確認信任鏈起點的根憑證）若缺失，初始化失敗現在會被妥善處理，不會讓這一步變成死結。macOS 的 keyring（存放登入金鑰的地方）若跳出互動式解鎖提示，等待時間也從 3 秒延到 60 秒。這版還補上 macOS keyring 的安全文件。像進大樓時保全發現名冊少一頁，會改走可處理的流程；而你正翻包找門禁卡，櫃台願意多等一分鐘。
body.en: When GitHub CLI starts, verifier initialization can fail because a trusted root—the root certificate at the start of a chain of trust—is missing. That failure is now handled gracefully instead of becoming a dead end. On macOS, an interactive keyring access prompt now gets 60 seconds rather than 3 seconds. This release also adds security documentation for the macOS keyring. It is like a guard finding a page missing from a visitor list and following a workable procedure, while the desk gives you a full minute to find your access card.

title.en: Project automation tidied: issue triage, deployment, and dependency updates

body.zh-TW: 這張卡講的是 gh 專案自己的後勤，不是你今天要輸入的新指令。團隊新增 pull request 範本、用代理分流 issue 的 workflow，也新增 Dependabot 的分流流程；issue 分流 workflow 改用 Actions token 做 Copilot 推論，並更新到 gh-aw v0.83.1。部署 workflow 加強，網站部署用的 `SITE_DEPLOY_PAT` 改由 gh-cli-site-deployer App 取代。CodeQL 的 Dependabot 更新會分組處理，Go 與多個函式庫、Actions 也陸續升版；無效的 CODEOWNERS 規則與程式、文件、註解的錯字一併清掉。像倉庫後場重新排班：分貨、交接、補貨都各自有路走，前台的 CLI 使用方式沒有因此多一道手續。
body.en: This card is about the gh project's own backstage work, not a new command for you to type today. The team adds a pull-request template, an agentic issue-triage workflow, and a Dependabot-triage workflow; the issue-triage workflow uses the Actions token for Copilot inference and is refreshed to gh-aw v0.83.1. The deployment workflow is hardened, and `SITE_DEPLOY_PAT` is replaced by the gh-cli-site-deployer App. CodeQL Dependabot updates are grouped, while Go, libraries, and Actions receive updates; a dead CODEOWNERS rule and typos in code, docs, and comments are removed. It is like reorganizing a warehouse back room: sorting, handoffs, and restocking each get their own route, without adding a step to the CLI counter.

title.zh-TW: 免登入下載公開專案的發布檔
title.en: Download public releases without authentication

body.zh-TW: 你是不是常在沒有登入帳號的乾淨電腦上，只想快速下載某個公開專案的安裝檔，卻被登入提示卡住？以往即使你想抓取的軟體是放在完全公開的專案中，執行命令時，系統還是會硬性要求進行 authentication（驗證程序，確認使用者身分的程序）才能下載。現在這個不方便的門檻被移除了，只要是公開專案，任何人都可以免登入直接把發布檔抓下來。這就像走進免費開放的市立圖書館拿一份導覽手冊，以前警衛還會擋在門口硬要你掏出借書證來登記，現在只要是公開擺在架上的東西，你推開門就能直接拿走。當你在新主機上需要快速抓取公開安裝檔時，這正是你輸入 `gh release download` 的時刻，保證一路暢通。
body.en: Have you ever tried to quickly fetch a release installer from a public repository on a clean system, only to be blocked by login prompts? Previously, even when a tool was hosted in a completely public project, trying to grab it would trigger a mandatory authentication (verification process confirming your identity) flow. We have now removed this hurdle, allowing anonymous access to all public releases. It is like walking into a public library to grab a brochure: the guard used to stubbornly demand your library card just to take a free leaflet, but now you can just walk in and take it. When you need to fetch a public installer on a new machine, that is when to run `gh release download` and download it without any hassle.

title.zh-TW: 廣納更多 AI 代理工具，技能安裝更聽話
title.en: More AI agents supported and smarter skill installation

body.zh-TW: 你正在為 AI 代理工具配置新的擴充能力，卻因為指令一直彈出不必要的提問而感到心煩？這次更新擴大了支援，讓 `gh skill` 指令能自動偵測更多第三方的 coding agents（寫程式碼代理，能協助撰寫程式碼的 AI 助手），並完整支援 `antigravity-cli` 與 `antigravity2.0`。此外，通用技能的預設安裝路徑也更正為 `~/.agents/skills`；更棒的是，如果你已經指定了安裝目錄參數，系統就不會再彈出冗餘的 prompt（互動提示，指程式在終端機中要求使用者輸入或選擇的畫面），會直接遵守你的選擇。這就像買了一支萬用遙控器，它學會了最新電視的頻率，而且當你指著電視按開關時，它不會再跳出選單囉唆地問你要遙控哪台設備。當你想自訂路徑且不想被打擾，這正是你使用 `gh skill` 指令的時刻。
body.en: Are you setting up custom capabilities for your AI helper, only to be annoyed by redundant terminal questions? This update expands the reach of the `gh skill` command to detect more third-party coding agents (AI assistants that help you write code) and officially support `antigravity-cli` and `antigravity2.0`. Under the hood, universal skills are now correctly routed to `~/.agents/skills`. Best of all, if you specify the installation path directly, the system will honor it without prompting (asking questions via terminal menu dialogs). It is like using a universal remote that supports the latest TVs; when you point it at the screen and press power, it no longer pops up a menu asking which device you wish to control. When you want a silent, customized install, that is when to run `gh skill`.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Codespace 轉發當機與 CI 狀態空白
title.en: Fixes for Codespace port forwarding crashes and blank CI summaries

body.zh-TW: 你是否遇過雲端開發環境突然崩潰，或是自動化檢查被取消後，狀態欄只顯示一片空白？這次修復專門為這些不穩定的角落提供保護。首先，處理 codespace port forwarding（連接埠轉發，將雲端開發機器的網路連接埠導引至本機的傳輸技術）時，背後因 concurrent map writes（併發寫入衝突，指多個處理程序同時修改同一份內部資料造成的當機錯誤）導致連線崩潰的問題已解決。此外，當 CI checks（自動化檢查）被全部取消時，摘要畫面的空白已被老實顯示的取消通知取代。這就像餐廳裡兩個服務生同時往同個格子上寫點單，紙張撕破導致系統當機的問題被修好了；而且如果整桌退單，看板也會清楚寫明「已取消」而非留下一塊讓人瞎猜的空白黑板。
body.en: Have you ever had your cloud development environment crash, or been left guessing when cancelled automation runs showed nothing at all? We have hardened these fragile areas. We resolved a crash where codespace port forwarding (connecting network ports of a remote container to your local machine) failed due to concurrent map writes (a data collision error when multiple processes modify the same memory table simultaneously). Additionally, if CI checks (automated checks) are cancelled, the summary screen now reports the status instead of displaying a blank void. It's like a restaurant fixing a glitch where two waiters writing on the same order ticket caused a system crash, and ensuring that if a table cancels, the kitchen screen displays "Cancelled" instead of an empty black board.

title.zh-TW: 資料庫識別碼升級與工作流安全性補強
title.en: Database ID upgrades and workflow security reinforcement

body.zh-TW: 當專案資料庫的識別碼數量日益膨脹，或是自動化工作流面臨被惡意修改的安全風險？為了解決底層的潛在危機，系統在多處細節做出了補強。首先，將 database IDs（資料庫識別碼，用來標示每筆資料唯一身分的數字代號）的資料型態升級為更大的 64 位元整數，防止隨著 GitHub 資料量成長而溢位。同時，將可重複使用的 triage workflows（工作流，特定事件觸發時自動執行的指令腳本）固定在特定的 commit SHA，防止工作流遭到篡改，並在說明中澄清了複製指令的行為。這就像將倉庫的舊鎖頭升級，把不夠大的抽屜換成超大保險櫃，並對自動門鎖裝上硬體鎖定，不管資料如何成長或外部如何變化，系統都能牢牢守護一切，不再因老舊漏洞而動搖。
body.en: Are you worried about database identifiers overflowing as records grow, or automated pipelines facing security threats from malicious changes? To address these underlying risks, we have reinforced several security and architectural details. The database IDs are now upgraded to 64-bit integers to prevent truncation on large data sets. Additionally, we pinned reusable triage workflows to a specific commit SHA to lock down their versions against unexpected alterations, and clarified command behavior in help files. It is like replacing shallow storage drawers with a giant vault and adding a physical lock to automated doors; the system stands secure and robust, unaffected by data growth or external tampering.

body.zh-TW: 你正在為專案尋找更多搜尋範例以提升開發效率，或者想讓部署流程跑得更穩定無誤？為了讓開發者使用更順暢，本次更新在搜尋文件補上了多個 qualifiers（限定符，用來過濾或精準匹配搜尋結果的修飾關鍵字）的實用範例，並修復了發布流程文件裡失效的 anchor link（錨點連結，指向網頁內特定段落的書籤連結）。同時，開發團隊也為多個內部依賴套件進行了版本升級。這就像重新繪製了大樓裡印錯的樓層指引招牌，並順手更換了多個老舊零件。這些微小的保養工作雖然不顯眼，卻能保證每位訪客都不會在大樓中迷路，也讓整座系統運作得更穩定安全。
body.en: Are you searching the documents for better query examples, or looking to keep your pipeline builds stable? To keep instructions clear, we added practical examples using multiple qualifiers and fixed a broken anchor link in the release guide. Additionally, several build and environment dependencies were updated. It is like fixing spelling mistakes on floor guide maps and swapping out standard elevator parts. Although these maintenance steps are small, they prevent visitors from getting lost and keep the whole building operating safely.

title.zh-TW: 新增直接讀取專案檔案與資料夾的指令
title.en: New commands to read repository files and directories directly

body.zh-TW: 你正在終端機前趕報告，突然需要快速確認專案裡某個設定檔的幾行內容，或是想看一下特定資料夾底下有哪些檔案？以往你可能得先用瀏覽器打開 GitHub 網站慢慢點，或是把整個專案下載到本機才能查看。這次新增了 `repo read-file` 與 `repo read-dir` 兩個新功能，讓你直接在終端機裡就能讀取專案檔案與資料夾內容。這就像在圖書館，你現在可以直接站在目錄櫃前查閱書名與特定章節，不用把整本書借回家慢慢翻。當你只想確認一下別人專案裡的 README（專案說明檔）寫了什麼，這正是你打 `gh repo read-file` 的時刻，不用花時間複製整個專案，就能直接在畫面上讀取內容。
body.en: Are you working in your terminal and need to quickly check the content of a configuration file in a repository, or see what files are in a directory? Previously, you had to open GitHub in a browser or clone the whole project locally. We've added two new features, `repo read-file` and `repo read-dir`, so you can inspect files and folders right from the command line. It's like standing at a library catalog card cabinet to check book titles or read specific chapters, without checking out the whole book. When you just want to check a remote project's instructions, that is when to run `gh repo read-file`, showing you the text instantly without cloning the project.

title.zh-TW: AI 技能管理更安全彈性
title.en: Safer and more flexible AI skill management

body.zh-TW: 你正在為 AI 助手安裝或升級新功能，卻擔心安裝到一半出錯，會把原本正常運作的工具搞壞？這次升級改良了技能安裝機制，在更新時會先在一個 temp dir（臨時資料夾）把檔案準備好，確認沒問題才進行 swap in-place（原地替換），避免升級中斷留下半殘的檔案。此外，如果你用 non-interactively（非互動模式，指程式自動執行不跳出確認提示的運行方式）進行安裝，系統也會自動列出所有可用技能，並支援自訂 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 指向特定的設定檔存放目錄。這就像裝修店面，以前工人在營業走道上敲打，停電就留下一地爛攤子；現在他們在後台工坊組裝好新櫃子，半夜一次完美換上。當你想把 AI 設定檔改存到自訂路徑，這正是你設定 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 的時刻。
body.en: Are you installing or upgrading new functions for your AI helper, but worried that a failure midway might break your working tools? The installation process is now much safer by staging updates in a temp dir (temporary directory) and executing a swap in-place (atomic replacement) only when ready, preventing broken files from failed upgrades. During automated non-interactively (non-interactive, running without user prompts) setups, the system now lists all available skills and lets you customize the directory. It is like renovating a shop: workers used to hammer in open aisles and leave a mess if the power failed; now they assemble cabinets in a back workshop and swap them overnight. When you want to store configs in a custom path, that is when to set `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`.

body.zh-TW: 當你打開專案的待辦清單，卻發現裡面塞滿了各種自動化工具產生的訊息，想把機器人發的項目快速挑出來看？以往在篩選由 bot（機器人，指自動化執行的程式帳號）所發送的 PR（拉取請求，要求合併程式碼變更的申請）或 Issue（問題回報，用來記錄臭蟲的項目）時，過濾選項藏得非常深。這次特別優化了這個功能在介面上的 discoverable（易於發現的特質），讓你一眼就能找到按鈕。這就像在凌亂的電子信箱裡，以前很難找到在哪裡篩選系統通知，現在介面上多了一個醒目的「依機器信件篩選」選項。這項優化讓你在尋找特定的機器人提報時，不再需要在一堆進階語法中瞎找過濾開關在哪裡。
body.en: Are you searching through repository lists and wanting to quickly pull up everything submitted by bots? Previously, filtering PRs (pull requests, proposals to merge changes) or Issues (bug tracking items) by bot authors (automated accounts) was hard to find in the interface. We have made filtering by bot authors much more discoverable, bringing the filter option forward. It is like looking at a cluttered email inbox where you had to write search queries to single out machine mail; now, an obvious option to filter by machine senders is placed right in view, saving you the hassle of hunting for the toggle.

We have bumped the Go language version in the devcontainer (development container providing unified environment) and upgraded various deps (dependencies, external libraries imported to run the app) to their latest versions. It is like replacing worn covers on instruction manuals and oiling machine parts. While these daily tasks bring no dramatic visual overhaul, they ensure the factory line runs smoothly and safely.

body.zh-TW: gh CLI 現在能直接在命令列操作 GitHub Discussions（討論區功能，社群提問與閒聊的看板）了，這是預覽版（preview，功能還在測試、之後可能調整）。新增「gh discussion」指令組：list 列出討論串、view 看內容、create 開新討論、edit 編輯，另外「gh discussion comment」可以直接留言或回覆別人的討論。內建的 gh 技能（skill，讓 AI 代理知道怎麼用 gh 指令的說明書）也同步補上這批 discussion 指令和 Issues 2.0 的用法說明。像原本只能用網頁逛的社群留言板，現在終端機也能直接開窗留言。
body.en: gh CLI can now drive GitHub Discussions (a community Q&A and chat board) straight from the command line — this is a preview (the feature is still being tested and may change). The new `gh discussion` command set covers `list`, `view`, `create`, and `edit`, and `gh discussion comment` lets you post or reply to a discussion directly. The built-in `gh` skill (a skill is a manual that tells an AI agent how to use `gh` commands) has also been updated with these discussion commands and Issues 2.0 usage notes. It's like a community message board you used to have to browse on the web now getting its own window right in your terminal.

It's like swapping a sticky note crammed with to-dos for a board where you can categorize, split into smaller notes, and draw connecting lines — managing a big project's issues no longer means cramming everything onto one list.

body.zh-TW: gh skill（技能，讓 AI 代理照著說明書做事的功能包）系列指令更好用了。新增「gh skill list」可以一次看清楚裝了哪些技能。「gh skill install」加上 --all 旗標，能把一個 repository（儲存庫）裡的技能全部裝起來，不用一個一個裝。「gh skill update --all」批次更新時，遇到缺 metadata（描述資訊）的技能會自動跳過、不會卡住整批更新。技能檔案放在比較深的巢狀資料夾裡，以前掃描不到，現在也找得到了。像倉庫裡的工具箱終於有清單可以點名，用 --all 一次裝齊、缺標籤的工具不會卡住盤點，藏在櫃子深處的工具也翻得出來。
body.en: The `gh skill` (a skill is a bundle of instructions that tells an AI agent how to do a task) command family got more usable. The new `gh skill list` shows everything installed at a glance. `gh skill install` gained an `--all` flag to install every skill in a repository at once instead of one by one. `gh skill update --all` now skips skills missing metadata (description info) instead of getting stuck on the whole batch. And skill files buried in nested subfolders, which used to go undetected, are now found too. It's like a warehouse toolbox finally getting an inventory list, one-click restocking, tools without labels no longer jamming the count, and gear buried deep in the cabinet finally turning up.

title.zh-TW: 身分驗證與 API 檢查更準了
title.en: Authentication and API checks get more accurate

body.zh-TW: 這批修的是幾個跟認證、API 檢查有關的準確度問題。以前 secrets（機密資訊，例如 API 金鑰）只能綁在使用者或 repository（儲存庫）上，現在也能讓 agent（代理，例如自動化機器人）以 application（應用程式身分）的名義使用 secrets。查詢 PR（pull request，程式碼合併請求）時，以前有個「只認編號」的優化捷徑會跳過 API 驗證，可能讓查詢結果不準，現在拿掉這個捷徑，改成每次都好好驗證。以前遇到 401（未授權）錯誤只丟出一個看不懂的錯誤，現在會直接印出「請跑 gh auth refresh」提醒你該重新驗證登入了。gh copilot 指令執行失敗時，以前只丟錯誤訊息，現在會提示你直接跑 copilot 指令排查。像 ATM 提款失敗時不再只顯示錯誤代碼，而是直接告訴你下一步該怎麼做。
body.en: This batch fixes a handful of accuracy issues around authentication and API checks. Secrets (sensitive values like API keys) used to be scoped only to a user or a repository; now an agent (an automated bot, for example) can also use secrets under an application identity. Looking up a PR (pull request) by number used to take a "number-only" shortcut that skipped API validation, which could return inaccurate results; that shortcut is gone, so every lookup is validated now. Hitting a 401 (unauthorized) error used to just print an unhelpful error; now it prints "run gh auth refresh" to tell you exactly what to do. When `gh copilot` fails to run, it now hints you to run the copilot command directly to troubleshoot, instead of just showing an error. It's like an ATM that no longer just flashes an error code when a withdrawal fails, but tells you directly what to do next.

title.zh-TW: 供應鏈安全再加固，發布版本鎖不可改
title.en: Supply-chain security tightens up; releases get locked

body.zh-TW: 這批是供應鏈安全（確保下載的軟體沒被竄改）的強化。gh release verify（驗證發布版本完整性的指令）現在會依 ref（版本標籤）長度自動判斷該用哪種 digest algorithm（雜湊演算法，驗證檔案有沒有被改過的方法），驗證更準確。CLI 建置流程把驗證用的 actions/attest-build-provenance 換成 actions/attest（GitHub 另一款官方認證動作）。專案的 GitHub Actions（自動化流程腳本）裡，first-party（GitHub 自己維護）的動作改用 SHA（固定版本雜湊值）釘死版本，不因對方改版悄悄變不同內容。文件也註記從 v2.93.0 起，GitHub Releases 會變 immutable（不可變更，發布後鎖死不能再改）。像貨物出廠前多蓋一層封條，用固定版號的檢驗員，貨才不會被中途調包。
body.en: This batch strengthens supply-chain security (making sure the software you download hasn't been tampered with). `gh release verify` (the command that checks a release's integrity) now derives the right digest algorithm (the hashing method used to verify content hasn't changed) from the length of the ref (version tag), making verification more accurate. The CLI's own build pipeline switched its verification action from `actions/attest-build-provenance` to `actions/attest` (another official GitHub-hosted attestation action). In the project's own GitHub Actions (automation scripts), first-party actions (ones GitHub itself maintains) are now pinned by SHA (a fixed version hash), so they can't silently change content if the upstream action gets updated. Docs also now note that starting with v2.93.0, GitHub Releases become immutable (locked after publishing — no more edits). It's like sealing a shipment before it leaves the factory and using an inspector who only checks a fixed batch number, so the goods can't be swapped mid-transit.

title.zh-TW: 安裝文件與 Windows 小毛病修掉
title.en: Install docs and a small Windows glitch fixed

body.zh-TW: 這批是安裝文件和小地方的修正。官方安裝指令說明更新了；某些 Linux 發行版（dnf 系）的安裝指令原本多帶了一段沒必要的 --repo gh-cli，也拿掉了；Windows 上執行某些指令時，背景會閃過一個 tzutil 主控台視窗，現在修掉了這個閃爍；文件裡重複打錯字、文法小錯也一併修正。其餘是外部 PR 審查流程、telemetry（遙測，回報使用狀況的統計資料）調整跟相依套件版本更新，不影響日常操作。像把說明書裡多餘的贅字和印刷錯字一次校完，操作起來更順眼。
body.en: This batch is installation-docs and small polish fixes. The official install command docs were updated; some Linux distros (the dnf family) had an unnecessary `--repo gh-cli` in their install commands, which is now removed; on Windows, running certain commands used to flash a tzutil console window in the background — that flicker is fixed; and a duplicated word plus a grammar typo in the docs were also corrected. The rest is extended PR-screening process work, telemetry (usage-reporting statistics) adjustments, and dependency version bumps that don't affect day-to-day use. It's like proofreading a manual to remove extra filler words and typos in one pass — everything just reads cleaner now.
